input.notes: Kitchen: replace leaking faucet, customer supplies faucet. Angle stop under sink seized, replace both stops + braided supply lines. ~2.5 hrs.
Toilet rocking and leaking at base. Pull toilet, new wax ring and closet bolts, reset. Also replace fill valve. 1.5 hrs.
Replace 50 gal gas water heater in garage, same location. Needs new expansion tank and gas flex line. Haul away old unit. Permit required.
Swap 8 outlets in kitchen to GFCI/standard tamper resistant (4 GFCI, 4 TR). Add 2 under-cabinet LED light strips on a new switch. Existing circuit ok.
Upgrade 100A panel to 200A. New meter base, service entrance cable, ground rods. Coordinate utility disconnect. Permit + inspection.
Install customer-supplied Level 2 EV charger in garage, 40A circuit, ~35 ft run from panel, panel has space.
Living room 16x20, 9ft ceilings. Walls 2 coats, ceiling 1 coat flat white, patch nail holes, trim not included. Furniture moved by owner.
Exterior 2-story 1800 sqft cedar siding. Pressure wash, scrape loose paint, prime bare wood, 2 coats acrylic. Trim + doors same color. Need lift for back.
AC not cooling. Found failed run capacitor 45/5 MFD and dirty condenser coil. Replace cap, clean coil, check charge.
Hang 3 shelves + TV mount (customer has mount, 65in TV). Fix sticking bedroom door. Re-caulk tub. Replace 2 cabinet hinges.
Move-out deep clean, 2 bed 1 bath apartment ~900 sqft. Inside oven, fridge, cabinets, windows inside. 2 cleaners ~5 hrs each.
Remove overgrown shrubs (6) along front, haul away. Install 8 new boxwoods 3gal, edging, 4 yards hardwood mulch.
Leak over back bedroom. ~40 sqft damaged shingles + decking soft in one spot. Replace decking sheet, underlayment, shingles to match, new pipe boot.
Replace kitchen mixer tap (customer supplied) and fit new isolation valves. 1.5 hrs.
fix deck, some boards rotten, railing loose
Replace 3 interior light fixtures with customer supplied LED fixtures, standard 8ft ceilings.
